Learn moreDETAILSREVIEWSMOREDescriptionSPREAD YOUR WINGS AND ENTER THE MAGIC DIMENSION! Fly into a brand new adventure in the Winx Club universe! Play as Bloom and dive into a magical world inspired by the series, full of iconic locations, mysteries and secrets to discover. TRANSFORM. TAKE FLIGHT. EXPLORE. - Transform at will, spread your wings and fly freely across the open world. - Rediscover the iconic locations of the series, such as Alfea, Cloud Tower, Red Fountain and Magix City. - On the ground and in the air, set out in search of the secrets of the Magic Dimension. EXPERIENCE AN ALL-NEW WINX STORY - The spectacular Festival of the 100 Moons was meant to be an unforgettable celebration… until everything goes wrong. A mysterious threat looms over the Magic Dimension. - Explore the world, master your magical powers, fight epic battles and meet the iconic Winx Club characters again in an adventure created especially for the game. TAKE ON 32 CHALLENGES WITH YOUR FAVORITE CHARACTERS - Extend the adventure beyond the main quest with 32 challenges across 4 game modes, to share with family or friends. - Unlock up to 24 playable characters from the Winx Club universe and play as your favorite heroines and heroes in a host of magical challenges. The Magic Dimension awaits. Transform, take flight and write a brand new Winx adventure!Show morePublished byBALIO STUDIO S.R.LDeveloped byBALIO STUDIO S.R.LRelease date11/30/2026Play withXBOX OneXBOX Series X|SCapabilitiesXbox local multiplayer (2-4)Single playerOptimized for Xbox Series X|SSmart DeliveryXbox achievementsXbox cloud saves XBOX consoles XBOX games XBOX Game Pass XBOX accessories XBOX News XBOX Support Feedback Community Standards Photosensitive Seizure Warning User Research at XBOX Microsoft account Microsoft Store Support Returns Orders tracking Store locations Rewards Games Designed for XBOX English (United States) Your Privacy Choices Opt-Out Icon Your Privacy Choices Consumer Health Privacy Sitemap Contact Microsoft Privacy & Cookies Manage cookies Terms of use Trademarks Third Party Notices Safety & eco About our ads

Please be aware that it cannot be played on Nintendo Switch™.In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle.Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.[About the Game]Befriend a Medley of Monsters- There's a whole host of monsters to befriend, including many familiar favorites from across the DRAGON QUEST series.- While each monster has its own traits and attributes, they can also learn a variety of talents, allowing you to fine tune your party to match your playstyle.- Combine two monsters via synthesis to create an even stronger creature, maybe even one you've never seen before.- Create a party of your favorite monsters that fights exactly the way you want. The possibilities are mind-boggling!A World Full of Wonder- With the game's unique visual style, you never quite know what lies beyond the curve of the horizon.- Each step forward reveals more about your surroundings, where new discoveries and fresh surprises await.Monsters by Your Side- Your monsters will follow you as you explore the world so you can enjoy every adventure together.- You can take any monster along with you, regardless of its type or size.Stay Competitive with Extra Content- Online features allow you to battle with monster wranglers the world over.- With a variety of modes to enjoy, from serious tournaments to friendly matches, there's plenty to try.- Send your strongest party into battle and be in with a shot at earning fantastic prizes!Software description provided by the publisher.Publisher notification(s):Early Purchase Bonus: Adventure Starter SetA handy item set that will help you get through the early stages of your adventure.Included Items[Contents]- 10x Monster Munchies- 3x Bonus Balls- 5x Seeds of SkillThis bonus is included only for customers who purchase the main game or the DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION by January 4th 2027 at 20:59 (PST).This content can be claimed from “Check Additional Content” in the in‑game menu.Digital Version Purchase Bonus: Hearty Meat SetA set of meat items used when scouting monsters.Included Items[Contents]- 5x Monster Munchies- 5x Smoked Sirloins- 5x Meaty TreatsNotesThis bonus is included only for customers who purchase the digital version of the main game or the DIGITAL DELUXE EDITION.This content can be claimed from “Check Additional Content” in the in‑game menu.*This game is only compatible with Nintendo Switch™ 2. Please be aware that it cannot be played on Nintendo Switch™.*There is also a Nintendo Switch™ version of this game. Please select the version you require carefully. *It is not possible to carry save data from the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version over to the Nintendo Switch™ version.*It is not possible to carry save data from the Nintendo Switch™ version over to the Nintendo Switch™ 2 version.Related tagsRole playingOnline scoreboardsRaise your statsVoiced charactersCompete onlineCross-platform playOnline co-opShow moreAbout this itemGame file size (estimated)11.7 GBSupported play modesTV modeTabletop modeHandheld modeNo. of playersSingle system (1)Online (1-4)Nintendo Account family-group lendingSupportedNintendo Switch OnlineOnline PlaySave Data CloudPlay online, access classic NES™ and Super NES™ games, and more with a Nintendo Switch Online membership.
